Either route may record an observed capability-unavailable negative; the chosen interactive host scope must demonstrate at least one actual human reply route. Synthetic regression artifacts are not real host proof.
evidence_contract.run_shape: A run file is one JSON object with no duplicate keys or non-finite constants. records, bindings, in_flight and current_subjects are required objects; in_flight has no default and names exact node ids, each with a nonempty attempt_id; an absent requested_mode takes execution.default_mode. A malformed run is reported invalid as a whole; a malformed record rejects only its node. records names exact node ids too. A present record that is not one readable attempt result is rejected and holds its node; run and attempt identities are non-blank text.
evidence_contract.independent_review: Every record carries a review-evidence artifact and an authors list. At least one successful dispatch must carry the record's review subject on its packet's first line and come from a provider that is not an author's; its packet and result bytes must match its receipt, its result must list findings and a non-empty checked scope, and every finding needs a recorded decision (not-a-defect or deferred) with a note. A fix is never claimed: changed bytes change the review subject and require a new bound dispatch. The review subject covers the node as the plan defines it, every field of the record except the plan digest, predecessor inputs, the qualification reference and run/attempt ids, and the other artifacts' hashes. Every review of the recorded revision, an author's own provider's included, needs its findings decided and is disclosed. Receipts are not authenticated: this stops a forgotten, stale or same-provider review, not a fabricated one.
evidence_contract.chain: Stages form one dependency chain and each extends files an earlier one wrote, so two nodes may own overlapping paths only when one depends on the other and the later one's profile and subjects hold the earlier one's. A record whose tested subject moved stays current while a later node in its chain is accepted with current subjects that include the earlier node's and a bound case map that holds every bound case of the earlier node's; the evaluator discloses each such discharge. A node waits while another owner of its paths has an unresolved attempt.
evidence_contract.direct_use: Every stage records a dated direct-use record of its check performed on this machine as the direct-use-evidence artifact. The evaluator holds its presence and hash, not its content; it stands beside the cases and never in place of one.

ui_projection.scope: Nine original positions and I/K default scope order; Studio inspects pending/resolved decision status only. Actual working CLI/app consumption owns the question and input-bound keep/ask application.
